row.business_description:
Yo Re Mi brings curriculum-based music and yoga education to NYC schools (Pre-school age 2 through 5th Grade). Through our unique combination of music and yoga, children learn with their bodies, minds, and voices all at once. We incorporate live music, movement and mindfulness while supporting curriculum goals. In addition to combining two enrichment classes into one, we celebrate the uniqueness of a child’s mind, honoring their creativity and imagination in a non-competitive environment. We proudly design and implement music and yoga curriculum for thousands of children in New York City area schools and daycare centers.

The Yo Re Mi app is a positive screen time solution — with no ads! Our engaging kids videos encourage daily movement, music and mindfulness while having fun! Distance learners, children, families and educators can now sing and stretch with us all over the world.

row.business_description:
Yo Re Mi helps educators bring the benefits of musical yoga and mindfulness to their students through teacher certification and
student enrichment programs.
We equip teachers, therapists, and homeschoolers with the skills, curriculum, and resources to deliver joyful, evidence-based
musical yoga sessions - no prior experience required. Our unique approach integrates live music, movement, and mindfulness to
support children’s physical, social, emotional, and mental health while fostering creativity, imagination, and self-confidence in a
non-competitive environment.
In addition to training and licensing educators nationwide, Yo Re Mi continues to bring curriculum-based enrichment programs
directly to students in schools (Preschool through 5th Grade) through classes, assemblies, in-school field trips, and on-demand
videos.
